senses.gloss: m. (ἀργέστης) the brightening, epithet of various winds (cmp. אִסְתָּן); West-North-West, West-South-West.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:15">Num. R. s. 13</cite> <he>אני מביא רוח א׳ וכ׳</he> I shall cause to pass over the world an argestes in which both winds (the Northern and the Southern) shall do service; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:16:1">Cant. R. to IV, 16</cite> <he>ארג׳</he>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 9:6">Lev. R. s. 9</cite> <cite ref="A02996"><he>ארגסטס</he></cite>; Ar. Var. <cite ref="A00361"><he>אגרסטיס</he></cite>.
